title: Kessler Care Extension of the Owner Rewards Points Expiry Period — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Plan-holder extension.** On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account, the expiry period that ages Owner Rewards points at a month-end run follows the customer's Kessler Care plans, as the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans records show, and the account's tier.

| The customer holds an active Kessler Care maintenance plan | Account tier | Expiry period lengthened by |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum | 6 months |
| Yes | Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 3 months |
| Otherwise | — | not lengthened by a plan |

Any active plan the customer holds counts, on any vehicle; a plan whose status is not active does not.

**Hypothetical.** A tier expiry period of 18 months becomes 24 months for a Gold account holder with an active plan, so a point earned 20 whole months before the run is not aged.
